description: This file defines API endpoints for authentication (signup, login, logout) using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and custom schemas. It contains route handlers managing user creation, authentication, and session termination, focusing on placeholder token management.

methods.name: AuthTokenResponse signup(payload: AuthSignupRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Creates a new user with provided email, display name, and password, then returns a token and user info. Handles duplicate email errors.

methods.name: AuthTokenResponse login(payload: AuthLoginRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returns a token and user info if successful.

methods.name: ApiMessage logout()
methods.description: Performs a placeholder logout by returning a message, without server state change.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^async def login(payload: AuthLoginRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session)) -> A/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^async def signup(payload: AuthSignupRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session)) ->/
